description: Fetch and normalize one known URL or shortlink. Use this first for direct user-supplied URLs, browser-rendered pages, social posts, and videos; YouTube watch/short/embed links get best-effort transcript enrichment when public captions are available. For a blocked commerce URL, pass likely product/title candidates from the conversation as reference_queries; catalog metadata is accepted only after exact URL identifier matching. smartfetch is the unified retrieval kernel: default structuredContent carries pipeline acquire attempt_map, assessment, and research_handoff metadata for downstream evidence/report consumers when results are partial or blocked. Do not use smartsearch when the user already provided the URL, and use smartcrawl only when you need multiple pages from the same site. Use exactly one budget control per call: output_budget, preferred_budget_chars, context_mode, or headroom_tokens. If smart-web returns reproducible incorrect or misleading output, open a GitHub issue on jojo-labs/smart-web with the exact input, arguments, observed output, expected behavior, and version. Skip obvious transient network/auth/rate-limit failures unless smart-web misclassified them.

context_mode.description: Coarse alias/backcompat fallback when no numeric budget control is supplied.

download.description: Prefer a downloadable asset result when the URL or discovered assets point to a file

export_body.description: Write normalized article body before inline clipping to a private local text artifact (at most 1 MiB). Returns body_export path/hash/characters/source completeness; does not make unavailable source content complete. No caller-selected path, raw DOM or browser state. Delete when no longer needed.

export_comments.description: Write normalized comments before inline clipping to a private local JSON artifact (at most 5000 comments/8 MiB). Returns comment_export path/hash/count/completeness; does not make unavailable comments complete. No caller-selected path, raw DOM or browser state is exported. Delete the artifact when no longer needed.

force_dynamic.description: Skip the impit/light fetch and go straight to Playwright browser rendering. Required for sites behind Cloudflare or similar bot protection (e.g. wikidocs.net) that return challenge pages instead of content via plain HTTP. Also useful when you know the page is a full client-side SPA and want to skip the initial failed fetch attempt.

format.description: Text rendering format for the human-readable content. Defaults to compact token-conscious text while structuredContent always carries projected JSON; use json only when the host needs JSON duplicated in text.

headroom_tokens.description: Null means absent. Approximate remaining host context tokens. Uses compact/balanced fallback only; request full explicitly with output_budget or preferred_budget_chars.

include_comments.description: Request source-bound discussion comments in addition to the article body. A body-only success does not complete this task; the approved local browser may continue once. Unknown or missing discussion rows remain partial.

output_budget.description: Explicit budget override. Use this for host-side manual control; preferred_budget_chars/headroom_tokens/context_mode are ignored when this is set.

preferred_budget_chars.description: Null means absent. Preferred output width hint from host/RPC budget metadata. Recommended for most host integrations. Mapped to compact/balanced/full by threshold and used before headroom/context_mode.

profile.description: Named browser profile for authenticated fetches (1-64 characters: letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens; must start with a letter or number and cannot end with a dot). Uses a persistent user-data-dir so cookies from a prior manual login are reused. Falls back to the fetch.browserProfile setting when omitted.

reference_queries.description: Contextual product/title candidates for a blocked commerce URL. The provider may query a public catalog, but accepts a result only when its exact product identifiers match the requested URL.

strict_schema.description: Return schema-safe fallback output when normalization breaks

target.description: Content type hint. Leave auto for normal use; youtube_video is for actual video routes such as watch, shorts, embed, live, or youtu.be links.

url.description: Direct URL or shortlink to fetch. Prefer this tool when the user already supplied a URL.

wait_for.description: CSS selector to wait for before capture (Playwright). Use when you know the page is an SPA that renders content into a specific element — e.g. '[data-reactroot]', 'svg.chart', '.content'. Without force_dynamic, the light fetch runs first; if it returns an SPA shell, Playwright auto-falls back using this selector.
